plugin.name: touchpad-gestures
plugin._long: Runs a command when three or four fingers swipe or pinch on a touchpad.

option.name: swipe_up_3
option._long: The command to run when 3 fingers swipe up on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: swipe_up_4
option._long: The command to run when 4 fingers swipe up on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: swipe_down_3
option._long: The command to run when 3 fingers swipe down on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: swipe_down_4
option._long: The command to run when 4 fingers swipe down on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: swipe_left_3
option._long: The command to run when 3 fingers swipe left on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: swipe_left_4
option._long: The command to run when 4 fingers swipe left on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: swipe_right_3
option._long: The command to run when 3 fingers swipe right on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: swipe_right_4
option._long: The command to run when 4 fingers swipe right on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: pinch_in_3
option._long: The command to run when 3 fingers pinch together on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: pinch_in_4
option._long: The command to run when 4 fingers pinch together on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: pinch_out_3
option._long: The command to run when 3 fingers spread apart on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: pinch_out_4
option._long: The command to run when 4 fingers spread apart on a touchpad. Empty for none.

option.name: swipe_distance
option._long: How far the fingers have to travel before a swipe counts, in the units the touchpad reports (roughly screen pixels at ordinary pointer speed).

option.name: pinch_change
option._long: By what share the fingers' spread has to shrink or grow before a pinch counts: 0.25 means to three quarters, or to four thirds.
